description: A caller can see that the model is ready.
steps: Boot the container and wait until the model has loaded
GET /healthz with no credentials
Receive 200 and {"status":"ok"}

description: A caller can see that the model is not ready yet.
steps: Start the process before the model load finishes
GET /healthz
Receive 503 and {"status":"loading"}

description: Each configured application can authenticate with its own key.
steps: POST /v1/transcribe with application A's bearer key and a short clip
See 200 and A's key id in the log, not the secret
Repeat with application B's key and see B's key id

description: A request with no key and a request with an unknown key are refused the same way.
steps: POST /v1/transcribe with no Authorization header
Receive 401 and {"error":"unauthorized"}
POST /v1/transcribe with a bearer token that matches neither hash
Receive the same status and the same body

description: A short clip comes back as text and a language code, and the temp file is gone.
steps: POST /v1/transcribe with a valid key and tests/fixtures/short.wav
Receive 200 and {"text","language"} equal to tests/fixtures/short.expected.json
Confirm the temp directory has no clip left

description: Audio over 5 MiB or over probe_duration_seconds is refused before the model runs.
steps: POST a file part larger than 5242880 bytes with a valid key
Receive 413 and {"error":"payload_too_large"}
POST a readable clip longer than probe_duration_seconds from whisper-api.conf
Receive 422 and {"error":"too_long"}

description: Unreadable bytes are refused, and a second call during inference is refused.
steps: POST a valid key and a body that is not audio
Receive 422 and {"error":"unreadable_audio"}
Start a transcription that holds the only slot
POST a second valid call and receive 429 and {"error":"busy"}
